analysis.support_validation: 12 test_candidate runs (<=15). Pair0 (reference): control 37.73 dB / CI 8/10 -> glass:4 39.53 dB / CI 10/10 (+1.80). Support pairs (control -> glass:4): pair1 33.33 -> 34.75 (+1.42, CI 6->8), pair2 40.01 -> 41.71 (+1.70, CI 7->7), pair3 35.33 -> 37.09 (+1.76, CI 8->7), pair4 29.09 -> 30.77 (+1.68, CI 8->10). All 5 pairs improve (+1.42..+1.80 dB, mean +1.67), none degrade. Glass:4 seed repeats on pair0: 39.52/39.53/39.54 (sigma <= 0.02 dB).
analysis.rationale: R1 re-analysis (pair0 primary, all 5 pairs re-analysed): (1) The R0-validated global step contrast_weaken_stretch:4 is retained: under glass:4 it reproduces target channel means within 0.04, std within 0.12 and spectral slope -3.741 vs -3.757 (|delta|=0.016<0.08); stretch +/-1 scans collapse to 32.02/32.01 dB vs 39.53 dB at sev4. (2) Blur subtype revised gaussian->glass: glass_score = 0.2462/0.2432/0.2321/0.2394 on pairs 0-3 (all within 0.02 of the 0.25 DT gate) and 0.5804 on pair4, so the Hybrid DT splits inconsistently across support (gaussian/gaussian/gaussian/motion/glass). Second-order signal after stripping the verified global: gradient-magnitude ratio target/sim = 1.36/1.40/1.56/1.50/1.40 for gaussian:4 (target systematically 35-55% sharper) vs 1.03/1.02/1.05/1.05/1.02 for glass:4; std matches target almost exactly under glass:4 (pair0 [15.81,16.24,22.28] vs target [15.78,16.23,22.40]) while gaussian:4 is too low ([15.41,15.86,21.74]). (3) No compression: block_boundary 0.9966-1.0098 (<1.05), unique_G 94-107 reproduced within 3 by glass:4 (CI block_boundary diff 2%; 10/10 CI on pair0); R0's jpeg test already degraded PSNR (35.69) and R0's jpeg-last block_boundary error was 223%. (4) No noise: noise_prior sigma 0.74-2.84; peeled §B on both gaussian and glass residuals is fully structured (spatial_corr 0.994/0.988), extreme_pct 60-62% is the documented extreme_pct false positive; no x_distortion noise function at sev1 is that weak. (5) No saturation: target Cr std is 5-13% ABOVE the simulation, so a desaturation step acts in the wrong direction. Decision: CHANGE to blur_glass:4 + contrast_weaken_stretch:4. Verdict remains UNCERTAIN because glass shuffle is stochastic and PSNR 30-40 dB band maps to UNCERTAIN per SKILL verdict rules; confidence comes from CI 10/10 (pair0/pair4), the cross-pair +1.4..+1.8 dB gain and the 1.02-1.05x gm match on all 5 pairs.
